WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC.title: Sacred Flask
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC.additionalRest: Instead of healing, restore Sacred Flask uses to [blue]{max}[/blue]
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC.description: At the start of each combat, add 1 Crimson Tears Sacred Flask to your hand. Sacred Flask can be used [blue]{count}[/blue] more times. Reaching a rest site restores Sacred Flask uses to [blue]{max}[/blue].
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC.flavor:
In pursuit of the Elden Ring, drifting to the graveyard──
That body gradually walking toward death,
with this, it can surely be healed.
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC_NEW.title: Sacred Flask+
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC_NEW.additional: Instead of healing, restore Sacred Flask uses to [blue]{max}[/blue]
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC_NEW.descriptio: At the start of each combat, add 1 Crimson Tears Sacred Flask to your hand. Sacred Flask can be used [blue]{count}[/blue] more times. Reaching a rest site restores Sacred Flask uses to [blue]{max}[/blue].
WYLDER-SACRED_FLASK_RELIC_NEW.flavor:
Baptized at the Church of Sacred Flask,
the maximum number of uses has increased.
WYLDER-RITUAL_SHIELD.title: Ritual Shield Talisman
WYLDER-RITUAL_SHIELD.description: When at full HP, attack damage taken is reduced by 30%.
WYLDER-RITUAL_SHIELD.flavor:
A combat ritual once offered to the Erdtree──
A talisman modeled after the shield used in the ritual.

The combat ritual was abolished in the age of Lord Consort Radagon,
and the arenas scattered about are its remnants.
WYLDER-RITUAL_SWORD.title: Ritual Sword Talisman
WYLDER-RITUAL_SWORD.description: When at full HP, attack damage dealt is increased by 20%.
WYLDER-RITUAL_SWORD.flavor:
A combat ritual once offered to the Erdtree──
A talisman modeled after the sword used in the ritual.

The combat ritual was abolished in the age of Lord Consort Radagon,
and the arenas scattered about are its remnants.
WYLDER-LUNE.title: Phantom of the Great Rune
WYLDER-LUNE.description: Each card you play accumulates 3 [gold]Charge[/gold] progress instead of 2.
WYLDER-LUNE.flavor:
A phantom in the shape of a Great Rune, floating in the air at the top of the Great Hollow Divine Tower.
Said to be a reflection of the Great Runes of the Lands Between.

It can enhance the naturally accumulated ultimate gauge.
WYLDER-WARRIOR_JAR_SHARD.title: Warrior Jar Shard
WYLDER-WARRIOR_JAR_SHARD.description: The first Attack card played each turn deals 50% more damage.
WYLDER-WARRIOR_JAR_SHARD.flavor:
A shard of a shattered Warrior Jar.

Softened corpse fragments cling tightly to the shard,
and among them, remnants of ornaments can still be seen.
It may be a relic of a former royal warrior.
WYLDER-MILLICENTS_PROSTHESIS.title: Millicent's Prosthesis
WYLDER-MILLICENTS_PROSTHESIS.description: Dealing attack damage accumulates 2 combo points. Playing non-Attack cards and at the end of turn reduces combo points. At 5/10/15/20 combo points, attack damage dealt is increased by 10%/20%/30%/50%.
WYLDER-MILLICENTS_PROSTHESIS.flavor:
A portion of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent.
The hand is fixed in a pose of raising a sword high.
WYLDER-CRUCIBLE_FEATHER.title: Crucible Feather Talisman
WYLDER-CRUCIBLE_FEATHER.description: Each time you play a Skill card, gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
WYLDER-CRUCIBLE_FEATHER.flavor:
A talisman made from feathers that were said to grow on human bodies in ancient times,
blending the diverse aspects of living things.

This is a remnant of the Crucible, the origin of life,
and a localized atavism that held sacred significance in ancient times.
However, as civilization developed, it came to be seen as a symbol of defilement.
WYLDER-LORD_OF_BLOODS_EXULTATION.title: Lord of Blood's Exultation
WYLDER-LORD_OF_BLOODS_EXULTATION.descrip: Whenever a creature's [gold]Bleed[/gold] triggers, you gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold].
WYLDER-LORD_OF_BLOODS_EXULTATION.flavor:
A talisman modeled after the joyful visage of the Lord of Blood.

　Offer blood to the Lord of Blood──
　Fill the chambers of the Lord's consort with blood, fill the cocoon with blood.
　When the young consort awakens, our dynasty shall begin.
